lead.headline: Conformal field theory from automorphic forms on a quantum group
body: We reformulate two-dimensional conformal field theory (2d CFT) in the language of noncommutative geometry. To this end, we introduce automorphic forms for the von Neumann algebraic quantum group $\mathrm{SL}^+_b(2,\mathbb{R})$.
A quantum measure space is a von Neumann algebra equipped with a weight. We study such spaces carrying a weight-preserving action of $\mathrm{SL}^+_b(2,\mathbb{R})$.

We argue that every unitary bosonic 2d CFT with central charge $c=1+6(b+b^{-1})^2>1$ is equivalent to a quantum measure space with an action of $\mathrm{SL}^+_b(2,\mathbb{R})\times\mathrm{SL}^+_b(2,\mathbb{R})$. In this dictionary, Virasoro primary operators are quantum automorphic forms and their scaling dimensions correspond to the spectrum of a quantum Laplace operator.

features.headline: Striped phases of N=4 SYM at finite density
body: We construct spatially modulated phases of strongly coupled $\mathcal N=4$ supersymmetric Yang--Mills theory at finite $R$-charge density. Compactification on a three-torus and unequal background charges isolate an unstable charge-density mode.
Its static threshold seeds a nonlinear branch of striped black branes in the STU model. The striped states have higher entropy than homogeneous states with the same energy and conserved charges.

features.headline: Quasi-Normal Modes and thermalization in integrable Quantum Field Theories from the Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz
body: We propose a Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz (TBA) approach for describing thermalization in integrable quantum field theories. The exponential damping and oscillations when approaching thermal equilibrium can be understood as the analogs of quasi-normal mode (QNM) frequencies of black hole perturbations within the framework of holography.

Holographic intuitions and some general properties of thermal Green's functions motivate the existence of such a TBA formulation, as well as lead to the imposition of a nonstandard analytical structure on the QNM TBA, while comparison with integrable form-factor expansions fixes the remaining ingredients.
features.authors: Zoltan Bajnok and Romuald A. Janik

features.headline: On phases of 4d $Spin/SO$ Yang-Mills theories
body: We study the low-temperature phase diagrams of $Spin(N)/SO(N)_\pm$ Yang-Mills theories as functions of the $θ$-parameter. In particular, for every even integer $N\geq 4$, we find a phase diagram consistent with the center/CP mixed anomaly, via the technique of mixed gauge theory.
The resulting phase diagrams are in perfect agreement with the phase diagrams of $Spin(N)/SO(N)_\pm$ super Yang-Mills theory softly broken by a small gaugino mass.

stories.headline: Form Factors in AdS from the Worldsheet
body: We study AdS form factors describing closed strings scattering off D-branes. Assuming that these form factors admit worldsheet integral representations in terms of multiple polylogarithms, we determine their leading curvature corrections around the flat-space limit by matching their pole structure to CFT data.

stories.headline: 5-brane webs and generalised symmetries
body: 5-brane webs provide a powerful geometric description of five-dimensional quantum field theories, encoding data such as symmetries and dualities. Although the extraction of continuous 0-form symmetries from these systems is well understood, their higher-form symmetries have received less attention.

stories.headline: Goldstone theory of gluon saturation in high energy QCD: From color glass to color superfluid condensate
body: In the high energy Regge asymptotics of QCD, the rapid overpopulation of gluons leads to gluon saturation, characterized by nonperturbative semi-classical lumpy configurations of size $1/Q_S$, where $Q_S\gg Λ_{\rm QCD}$ is a dynamical semi-hard saturation scale.
stories.authors: V. P. Nair and Raju Venugopalan

stories.headline: Exact Splitting of Amplitudes and One-Loop Integrands: A Classical Origin of Zeros
body: We introduce a recursion based on hidden zeros that reconstructs complete tree level scattering amplitudes and one-loop integrands at generic kinematics. The recursion takes a universal exact-splitting form: both tree amplitudes and one-loop surface integrands are expressed as sums of products of complete tree functions, with the chosen zero conditions manifest in every term.

stories.headline: Anomaly effective actions for 4d $\mathcal{N}=1$ superconformal field theories
body: We present a comprehensive analysis of the Wess-Zumino anomaly effective action of four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ superconformal field theories in components. After reviewing the coset construction of the Wess-Zumino action in the presence of an unbroken subgroup, the gauging of the conformal algebra and the Wess-Zumino effective action for non-supersymmetric conformal field theories with a U(1) symmetry in two and four dimensions, we revisit the superconformal anomalies of $\mathcal{N}=1$ conformal supergravity.

stories.headline: Spectral flow in AdS$\mathbf{_3}$ revisited
body: We revisit an old idea that spectral flow in WZW models can be associated with certain $G$-bundles over a worldsheet. This allows us to introduce a novel method for computing correlators of spectrally-flowed vertex operators in WZW models with group $G$ and level $k$, by systematically computing the contribution from a network of line defects.

stories.headline: Static and dynamical Casimir effects in a wedge within the worldline formulation
body: We study a real massless scalar field in $d+1$ dimensions confined to a wedge of opening angle $α$, in the presence of a semitransparent circular arc that may oscillate radially. Within the worldline formulation, and for an arbitrary strength $λ$ of the $δ$-potential that models the arc, we expand the effective action in powers of the radial displacement $R$ of the arc.
stories.authors: César Daniel Fosco and Bruno Cardin Guntsche

stories.headline: Schwinger Effect with a Transversal Boundary
body: We study the effect of a boundary on pair production by an electric field. In particular, we are interested in the case in which the electric field has a normal component with respect to the boundary.
This is essentially more complex than pure tangential fields due to the reflection of created particles against the boundary.

stories.headline: The quasi-topological space of quasi-topological gravities
body: We investigate general properties of quasi-topological theories of gravity involving infinite towers of polynomial densities and of their regular vacuum black hole solutions. We show that every positive-mass regular vacuum solution necessarily possesses a de Sitter core, while Minkowski and anti-de Sitter cores are excluded.

stories.headline: Gravitational-Wave Constraints on $R^2$ Gravity
body: Gravitational waves from compact binary coalescences provide a unique opportunity to test general relativity in the strong-field regime. Quadratic $f(R)=R+aR^2$ gravity is among the simplest higher-curvature extensions of general relativity and introduces a massive scalar degree of freedom whose finite interaction range can modify compact-binary dynamics and gravitational-wave emission.
stories.authors: Pawan Kumar Gupta and Laura Sagunski

stories.headline: The Start Time of Ringdown
body: We determine the convergence of quasi-normal modes sums for a point-particle plunging into a Schwarzschild black hole. While a dynamical amplitude model reproduces the waveform after the particle crosses the bounce radius, a constant amplitude sum converges only after the start time $t_S$, which corresponds to the advanced time at which the particle hits the central singularity.

briefs.headline: Topology change and the Gauss Bonnet term in causal set theory: the sign of the cosmological term and the axion decay constant
briefs.text: Causal set theory permits changes of spatial topology without the metric degeneracy that forbids them in continuum Lorentzian gravity. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Higher Integrability, Generalized Symmetries, and Partially Topological Field Theories
briefs.text: We exhibit a classical link between higher Lax integrability and generalized symmetries in a non-Lorentzian higher semi-holomorphic Chern--Simons theory on $M\times\mathbb CP^1$.

briefs.headline: A dynamical Einstein-Proca-dilaton holographic model and exotic hybrid meson resonances
briefs.text: A fully dynamical Einstein-Proca-dilaton (EPD) holographic model is developed for the exotic $J^{PC}=1^{-+}$ hybrid meson, incorporating the backreaction of the massive vector field dual to the hybrid current in the bulk.

briefs.headline: Gluon and Faddeev--Popov ghost propagators in rotating background: An eigenfunction approach
briefs.text: We construct the free gluon and Faddeev--Popov ghost propagators in rigidly rotating cylindrical coordinates using an eigenfunction approach within the Feynman gauge.

briefs.headline: Partially Massless Condensates and Reentrant NUT/Bolt Phase Transitions in Conformal Gravity
briefs.text: We study non-Einstein Bach-flat Taub-NUT/Bolt instantons with weakened AdS boundary conditions.

briefs.headline: Chiral edge modes from lattice Chern-Simons theory
briefs.text: It is shown that a level $k$ Abelian lattice Chern-Simons theory with continuum time and a spatial square lattice, which is a topological field theory on the latticized plane and torus, when quantized on a spatial cylinder reduces to chiral edge excitations, exactly localized on the two boundaries and carrying two commuting lattice versions of the level-$k$ $U(1)$ Kac-Moody algebra of opposite chirality.

briefs.headline: Complex phase diagram and thermodynamic supercriticality of five-dimensional four-charge AdS black holes in $STU-W^2U$ gauged supergravity
briefs.text: In this paper, we investigate the complex phase structure and thermodynamic supercriticality of static four-charge anti-de Sitter (AdS) black holes in five-dimensional $STU-W^2U$ gauged supergravity, with all four physical electric charges held fixed.

briefs.headline: Satisfying Freed--Witten quantization on smooth divisors in Calabi--Yau orientifolds
briefs.text: Freed--Witten quantization conditions on several divisors wrapped by D-branes must be satisfied with one bulk $B$-field.

briefs.headline: Bumblebee radiation from neutral matter around a black hole
briefs.text: We investigate bumblebee radiation generated by neutral matter orbiting a black hole with a radial spacelike vector vacuum. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Exact thermal correlators at vanishing momenta and the black hole singularity
briefs.text: We study thermal two- and three-point functions of scalar primaries in holographic CFTs dual to AdS black branes.
